standard.title: Temephos, Emulsifiable Concentrate (EC) — Specification (First Revision) (टेमीफॉस, इमल्सीफिएबल सांद्र (ई.सी.) — विशिष्टि (पहला पुनरीक्षण))
standard.sector: Food and Agriculture / Pesticides and Pesticide Residues

standard.description: This standard prescribes the requirements, packaging standards, and the methods of sampling and test for temephos, emulsifiable concentrates (EC), which are widely used as larvicides in public health and agricultural pest-management campaigns.
standard.scope: This standard prescribes the requirements, packaging standards, and the methods of sampling and test for temephos, emulsifiable concentrates (EC), which are widely used as larvicides in public health and agricultural pest-management campaigns.

amendments.summary: No active amendments have been issued on this standard (NIL on this copy).

certification.description: Voluntary/Mandatory under the Insecticides Act. Manufacturers are encouraged to apply for the prestigious BIS 'Standard Mark' (ISI Mark) to print on product containers as a certified assurance of quality. Additionally, all packaging, labeling, and distribution of temephos emulsifiable concentrates must strictly comply with statutory registrations and warning declarations mandated under the Insecticides Act, 1968 and Rules framed thereunder.
requirements: Temephos emulsifiable concentrate shall consist of temephos technical dissolved in suitable solvents with emulsifiers, forming a clear, homogeneous liquid, free from sediment and suspended matter.

The actual temephos content of the formulation (commonly commercialized in strengths like 50 percent EC) shall be calculated to the second decimal place and then rounded off to the first decimal place before applying the permitted tolerances of the nominal value.

When determined by the method prescribed in Clause 13.5 of IS 6940, free acidity (calculated as H2SO4) of the emulsifiable concentrate shall not exceed 0.5 percent by mass to prevent formulation decomposition and packaging corrosion.

Requires passing the cold test. The concentrate must remain homogeneous without any crystallization, solid separation, or liquid-phase division when maintained at cold temperatures (typically 0°C or 10°C), ensuring performance stability in cold weather.

The material must form a stable emulsion upon dilution with standard hard water. Minimal creaming, oil separation, or sediment accumulation must be achieved after standing, guaranteeing uniform field application.

The material must be packed in clean, dry containers made of mild steel, tin plate, or aluminium. To prevent corrosion or chemical reactions, mild steel or tin plate containers must be suitably and properly internally lacquered.

Each container must legibly and indelibly bear: the name of the product, manufacturer's name and address, batch number, date of manufacture, date of expiry, net volume, nominal temephos content (percent m/m), and standard cautionary warnings in strict accordance with the Insecticides Act, 1968.

Any observed or calculated test or analysis value expressing active ingredient content, moisture, acidity, or physical properties must be mathematically rounded off in accordance with IS 2 : 1960. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be identical to the specified value in the standard.
